cycle10Findings.R2F10_1: apps/product-api/src/routes/project.ts generates a fresh occurredAtUtc for every submit/accept/waive HTTP attempt. Since handlers fingerprint this field, same-key same-payload public retries can fail with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_PAYLOAD instead of replaying.
cycle10Findings.R2F10_2: initialize replay does not bind every immutable requirement/action fact to the normalized command and receipt, and the generic replay fact validator permits extra unique action types. Coordinated authoritative aggregate plus receipt tamper can pass.

cycle11Finding.R2F11_1: Initialize replay compared requirement security facts only with the current node, so coordinated node plus requirement securityEpoch/domain tamper could pass while the initialized event retained the original facts.

priorR2F9Evidence.R2F9_1: All four command fingerprints include normalized occurredAtUtc; Memory/SQLite regression tests passed.
priorR2F9Evidence.R2F9_2: Production SqlitePersistence contains no 517 mapping; controlled CAS helper requires a fresh target-version advancement proof.

r2f10Evidence.R2F10_1: Public submit/accept/waive routes reuse an existing scoped receipt createdAtUtc; same-key same-payload HTTP retries replay, different payloads still mismatch, client occurredAtUtc is rejected, and authorization continues to use persistence trusted time.
r2f10Evidence.R2F10_2: Initialize replay binds the full normalized pending@v1 aggregate, current node security facts, receipt creation time and exactly one initialized action; Memory/SQLite coordinated reviewer and extra-action tamper fail closed without new durable facts.
